text: Completed codec ownership without changing existing v1 scheduler bytes. AgentDomainJson now has no Circe-derived codecs: every sum discriminator and product field is explicit, historical case-name tags remain pinned by agent-scheduler-shapes-v1.json, ambiguous discriminators are rejected, and additive unknown fields remain accepted. Added typed additive AgentFailure payloads with legacy message-only and unknown-code fallback, plus SSH ADT reconstruction tests. The language-neutral agent-methods-v1.json registry covers every request method with non-ASCII envelope round trips. Existing P6f.34 round-trip, malformed-input, unknown-field, bounds, framing, canonicalization, journal replay, and sensitivity laws remain green. Verified protocol/test, ssh/test, agent/test, and scalafmtCheckAll on Scala 3.3.8.
